def check_solution():
    test_cases = [
        {"capacity": 0, "ops": [["put", 1, 2], ["get", 1]], "expected": [-1]},
        {"capacity": 1, "ops": [["put", 1, 4], ["put", 2, 5], ["get", 1], ["get", 2]], "expected": [-1, 5]},
        {"capacity": 2, "ops": [["put", 1, 1], ["put", 2, 2], ["get", 1], ["put", 3, 3], ["get", 2]], "expected": [1, -1]},
        {"capacity": 2, "ops": [], "expected": []},
    ]

    for i, test_case in enumerate(test_cases):
        result = solve(test_case)
        assert result == test_case["expected"], f"Test case {i+1} failed: expected {test_case['expected']}, got {result}"
        print(f"Test case {i+1} passed.")

check_solution()
